readme: the cardio model - read by buildAppData.py into appData/targets.json (efforts, lights, default target) and appData/exercises.json (each cardio exercise's default effort, plus the added activities)
made in the 2026-10-10 research round (the talk test, session RPE, the 3-zone model, WHO 2020); sources in data/sources.md
efforts: what the user picks after a session; zone = which of the three zones its minutes count in
lights: the two cardio lights; zones = how much of a minute in each zone lights it
defaultTarget: weekly minutes per light with no preset on (90 easy + 2 x 30 hard = the WHO 150)

efforts.label: Easy
efforts.hint: Breathing harder than resting, but you could chat in full sentences.

efforts.label: Hard
efforts.hint: Short phrases only. A strong pace you could hold for 20 to 60 minutes.

efforts.label: Very hard
efforts.hint: A word or two at most. Intervals, sprints, race efforts.

lights.name: Easy cardio
lights.explain: Your aerobic base: time spent at a pace where you could still chat. Long, easy sessions that build endurance.

lights.name: Hard cardio
lights.explain: Time spent too hard to chat: tempo runs, intervals, sprints, hard games. Each minute counts double toward the health guideline.

Bicycling.note: Commuting and leisure riding is mostly chatty. Hill efforts or group rides: Hard.

Bicycling_Stationary.note: Steady spinning. Interval programmes: Very hard.

Elliptical_Trainer.note: About 5 METs at a moderate setting.

Jogging_Treadmill.note: Jogging is a conversational pace by definition.

Prowler_Sprint.note: All-out sled pushes. Log the block of pushes plus the rests between them.

Rope_Jumping.note: About 11 METs; few people can chat while skipping. Fast rounds or double-unders: Very hard.

Rowing_Stationary.note: Steady rowing under about 100 W. Timed pieces (500 m, 2 km): Very hard.

Running_Treadmill.note: Running (not jogging) is usually above the chatty pace. Pick Easy if you could chat.

Stairmaster.note: Stair machines are about 9 METs; short phrases at best for most people.

Trail_Running_Walking.note: Mostly chatty with hill spikes. A hard trail run: Hard.

Walking_Treadmill.note: Steep incline walking can be Hard.

Running_Outdoor.name: Running (outdoors)
Running_Outdoor.note: Same as treadmill running. Easy runs go in as Easy.

Walking_Brisk.name: Brisk walk
Walking_Brisk.note: Counts toward health minutes when you are breathing harder than at rest.

Hiking.name: Hiking
Hiking.note: Steep climbs with a pack can be Hard.

Sprint_Intervals.name: Sprint intervals
Sprint_Intervals.note: Track, hill or field sprints. Log the sprint block plus the rests between sprints.

Swimming_Laps.name: Swimming laps
Swimming_Laps.note: Rate by feel: the talk test does not work in water, and heart rate runs lower than on land.

HIIT_Circuit.name: Circuit / HIIT class
HIIT_Circuit.note: Burpees, Tabata and the like. Also use this for a short-rest weights circuit.

Air_Bike_Intervals.name: Air bike intervals
Air_Bike_Intervals.note: Assault or echo bike sprints. Log the interval block.

Spin_Class.name: Spin class
Spin_Class.note: Mixed class, mostly above the chatty pace.

Team_Sport_Game.name: Team sport game
Team_Sport_Game.note: Football or basketball games average close to threshold heart rate.

Racket_Sport.name: Racket sport
Racket_Sport.note: Singles tennis, squash, badminton. Doubles tennis is closer to Easy.

Boxing_Bag.name: Boxing / bag rounds
Boxing_Bag.note: Timed rounds. Hard sparring or all-out rounds: Very hard.
